results.title: Delhi H1N1 Cases Surge To 1,777: Swine Flu Infections Rise Nearly 8-Fold; Check Symptoms & Health Advisory
results.description: Swine flu infection has taken over Delhi and has seen a sharp rise in seasonal influenza and H1N1 cases this monsoon.

results.title: Saudi Arabia orders health insurers to provide outpatient coverage without prior approval
results.description: Unlike conventional plans that may require insurers to approve certain outpatient services before beneficiaries receive care, the new option will remove the pre-approval requirement for eligible outpatient services.
